blocks.text: Jab thori si different (alag alag) frequencies wali do waves ek hi direction (simt) mein chalte hue ek doosre par aati (overlap) hain, to sound (awaz) baar baar oonchi aur dheemi hoti hai (zyada se zyada aur kam se kam loudness ke darmiyan periodic tabdeeli). Isi ko beats kehte hain.

Tuning forks pure (khalis) notes dete hain, yani sirf ek frequency. Agar ek jaisi frequency (jaise 32 Hz) ke do tuning forks A aur B alag alag bajaye jayein to dono pure note dete hain. Agar dono ek saath bajayein to ek ka note doosre se alag pehchanna mushkil hota hai; dono ki sound waves superpose ho kar insani kaan ko ek hi pure note sunai deti hain.

Agar fork B par thora sa wax (mom) ya plasticine laga diya jaye to us ki frequency thori kam ho jati hai, jaise 28 Hz. Ab dono forks ek saath bajayein to aisa note sunai deta hai jis ki intensity (shiddat) baari baari barhti aur ghatti hai. Is note ko beat note ya beat kehte hain; yeh forks A aur B ki sound waves ke interference se banta hai.

Fig. 7.12 (a) fork A ke note ka waveform aur Fig. 7.12 (b) fork B ke note ka waveform dikhati hai. Jab dono forks ek saath bajte hain to resultant waveform Fig. 7.12 (c) mein hai; yeh batata hai ke beat note kaise banta hai. Kisi instant (lamhe) X par dono waves ka displacement ek hi direction mein hai, is liye resultant displacement bara hai aur oonchi sound sunai deti hai.

blocks.alt: Waqt ke sath teen waves (lehrein) oopar neeche. (a) fork A ki wave (lehar), (b) fork B ki thori lambi wave, (c) dono ka result (nateeja), jis ka size dashed ghere ke andar barhta ghatta hai. Teeno par dashed lakeeren X (oonchi), Y (dheemi) aur Z (oonchi); X se Y aur Y se Z 1/8 s, aur X se Z 1/4 s. Resultant wave likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.12: Beats ka banna (kitab ki Figure 7.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: A ki frequency 32 Hz aur B ki 28 Hz hai. X par dono ke crest ek saath: oonchi sound. 1/8 s baad (Y) A, B se aadha chakkar aage nikal jata hai, to dono ek doosre ko khatam karti hain: dheemi sound. 1/4 s par (Z) phir oonchi. Yani har 1/4 s mein ek beat, ek second mein 4 beats = 32 − 28.
1/8 s baad ek fork ki wave ka displacement doosre fork ki wave ke ulat hota hai, is liye Y par displacement kam se kam hota hai aur dheemi sound ya koi sound nahi sunai deti.
Phir aur 1/8 s baad displacements phir ek hi direction mein hote hain aur Z par phir oonchi sound sunai deti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka text Y ko X se '1/4 s baad' aur Z ko Y se 'aur 1/4 s baad' likhta hai. 4 beats per second ke saath ek loud sound se agli tak 1/4 s hai, is liye loud se dheemi (X se Y) 1/8 s aur dheemi se loud (Y se Z) aur 1/8 s hai, jaisa kitab ki apni Fig. 7.12 bhi dikhati hai.
Dono forks ki frequencies ka farq bhi 4 Hz hai, yani ek second mein beats ki number (tadaad) dono tuning forks ki frequencies ke farq ke barabar hai:

blocks.text_alt: f_A = 32 Hz,  f_B = 28 Hz,   f_A > f_B
Beats ki tadaad = f_A − f_B = 32 Hz − 28 Hz = 4

blocks.text: Lekin jab do sounds ki frequencies ka farq 10 Hz se zyada ho to beats pehchanna mushkil ho jata hai.

blocks.text: Sound longitudinal hai: hawa ki layers (tehein) wave ki direction mein aage peeche hilti hain, is liye compression aur rarefaction bante hain. Light transverse hai: crest aur trough. Kitab longitudinal wave ka Amplitude khara (vertical) teer bana kar dikhati hai; asal mein layers wave ki direction mein hilti hain, is liye yahan Amplitude ko wave ki direction mein chhote do-teer se dikhaya gaya hai.

Beats se piano ya violin jaise string instruments (taar wale saaz) tune kiye ja sakte hain: instrument ka note kisi maloom frequency ke note ke saath bajayein. Phir string ko kas kar ya dheela kar ke tab tak theek karein jab tak beats sunai dena band na ho jayein; tab dono frequencies barabar hoti hain.
Beat Frequency (f_beat)
Do waves ki frequencies ke farq ko beat frequency f_beat kehte hain. Do consecutive loud sounds ke darmiyan time interval (waqfa) T = t₂ − t₁ ho to:
Musical instruments ki tuning
Musical instruments mein beats kaise bante hain, is ki kuch misalein:

items: Guitar: thori different tuning wali do strings bajane se beats bante hain, jaise ek standard tune ki hui string aur ek string jo chand cents (bohat thora) oonchi ya neechi tune ho.
Piano: saath saath wali do keys, safed aur kaali, bajane se beats bante hain.
Violin: do strings ko bow (gaz) ke thore different pressure (dabao) ya speed (raftar) se bajane par beats bante hain.
Drums: thori different tuning wale do drums ek saath bajane se beats bante hain.
Flute: honton aur chehre ke muscles ki thori different position (embouchure) se do notes bajane par beats bante hain.
Organ: thori different tuning wale do pipes bajane se beats bante hain.
Synthesizer: thori different frequencies wale do oscillators chalane se beats bante hain.

blocks.title: Do you know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Zyada tar string (taar wale) aur wind (hawa wale) musical instruments ki sound un ke andar stationary (standing) waves banne se paida hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Saaz bajane walon ka line drawing, har ek par saaz ka naam: guitar (oopar baen), violin (oopar daen), cello (baith kar, baen), grand piano (keyboard par pianist, daen), clarinet (baen), trombone (beech mein), recorder (daen), flute (neeche baen) aur trumpet (neeche beech mein).
blocks.caption: Do you know? (PDF page 160): string (taar wale) aur wind (hawa wale) musical instruments bajane wale (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Guitar, violin, cello aur grand piano mein taar (string) par stationary waves banti hain; clarinet, trombone, recorder, flute aur trumpet mein tube ke andar hawa ke column mein. Isi liye do saaz thore se mukhtalif tune hon to beats sunai dete hain.
In sab misalon mein do sound sources ki frequency ka thora sa farq amplitude ko baar baar barhata aur ghatata hai, jis se "beat" ya pulsation (dhadkan) jaisa effect banta hai.

Musicians aksar jaan boojh kar beats istemal karte hain taake interesting (dilchasp) rhythm, sound mein texture (gehraai), ya tension aur release (tanao aur sukoon) ka ehsas paida ho. Lekin kabhi beats unwanted (na-pasand) hote hain, aur un ka effect kam karne ke liye tuning, pitch ya bajane ke tareeqe mein tabdeeli karni parti hai.

blocks.title: Example 7.7
blocks.problem: Do tuning forks 3 Hz beat frequency ke beats dete hain. Ek fork ki frequency 256 Hz hai. Phir us fork ke ek prong (daante) par thora wax laga kar us ki frequency thori kam ki jati hai, aur ab dono forks 1 Hz beat frequency dete hain. Doosre tuning fork ki frequency nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: pehle fork ki frequency f₁ = 256 Hz; wax se pehle beat frequency = 3 Hz; wax ke baad = 1 Hz; doosre fork ki frequency f₂ = ?
Beats ki number n = frequencies ka farq: f₁ − f₂ = ±n, yani f₂ = f₁ ± n.
f₂ = 256 ± 3, yani f₂ = 259 Hz ya 253 Hz.
Agar f₂ = 259 Hz hota: wax lagane ke baad pehle fork ki frequency 256 se neeche (255, 254 Hz) jati, to farq 3 se barh jata (4, 5 beats). Lekin beats kam ho kar 1 hue, is liye 259 Hz sahi nahi.
Agar f₂ = 253 Hz ho: wax ke baad pehla fork 254 Hz ho jata hai, aur 254 − 253 = 1 Hz, jo sawal se milta hai.
blocks.answer: Doosre fork ki sahi frequency f₂ = 253 Hz hai.

blocks.prompt: Tuning fork A fork B ke saath per second 4 beats paida karta hai; B par wax lagane se beat frequency 6 ho jati hai. Agar A 320 Hz ho to wax lage B ki frequency nikalein (numerical 7.3). Frequency ka farq 10 Hz se zyada hone par beats pehchanna mushkil kyun hai (constructed response 7.5)?
blocks.explanation: B = 320 ± 4 = 324 Hz ya 316 Hz. Wax B ki frequency kam karta hai; beats 4 se barh kar 6 sirf tab hote hain jab B pehle hi A se neeche ho, to B = 316 Hz aur wax lage B ki frequency = 320 − 6 = 314 Hz. Agar farq 10 Hz se zyada ho to ek second mein 10 se zyada baar sound oonchi neechi hoti hai; kaan itni tezi se is utaar charhao ko alag alag nahi sun pata, aur beats dhadkan ki bajaye ek rough (khurdari) sound ban jate hain.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Beats: ek direction mein chalti, thori different frequency wali do waves se sound baar baar oonchi aur dheemi hoti hai.
Ek second mein beats = f_A − f_B (32 − 28 = 4); f_beat = 1/T; 10 Hz se zyada farq par beats pehchanna mushkil.
Beats se saaz tune kiye jate hain; guitar, piano, violin, drums, flute, organ, synthesizer mein beats bante hain.
Example 7.7: doosra fork 253 Hz (259 Hz se beats barhte, kam nahi hote).
